underlines.text: was particularly flattered by receiving the invitation from Mr. Bingley himself, instead of a ceremonious card

reference.text: The two young ladies were summoned from the shrubbery, where this conversation passed, by the arrival of some of the very persons of whom they had been speaking; Mr. Bingley and his sisters came to give their personal invitation for the long expected ball at Netherfield, which was fixed for the following Tuesday.
